messages:
tess: Quick note from pilot calls — customers want per-route cost but will accept a short-term CSV while we build UI. Proposing a narrow MVP: cost snapshot + CSV export + trace-button that uses trace_id in metrics.

omar: +1. Keep it small. Suggest default sampling 0.5% and tenant override for Dedicated. Add a simple webhook for cost spikes as alpha.

rachel: Engineering estimates: trace_id -> metrics plumbing ~4 dev-days, CSV + small dashboard card ~3 dev-days, webhook alpha ~2 dev-days, infra indexing ~3 dev-days. Total ~12 dev-days across squads.

tess: Launch gates (proposal): 1) accuracy: snapshot within 5% vs billing for top-20 tenants over 7d; 2) UX: trace-button opens correct trace <=2s for sampled traces 95% of the time; 3) perf: card render p95 <700ms; 4) reliability: CSV/webhook success >=99% in canary; 5) privacy signoff.

omar: Rollout: internal dogfood -> 3 pilot customers (ask CS) -> expand to 20 over 2 weeks -> GA. Feature flag + kill-switch.

rachel: I'll open RD-55444 and split tasks, attach estimates. dev-bot: create canary cohort doc.

dev-bot: Created ticket RD-55444: "console: obs-mini MVP (cost snapshot + CSV + trace-link + webhook alpha)" assigned to @rachel, due 2026-05-10.

tess: Decision: ship the narrow MVP. Defer per-route explorer and 30d retention to v2. Action items: rachel split RD-55444 (EOD), omar draft acceptance tests (Tue), CS to recruit pilots (Mon), infra to prepare kill-switch. Demo in next sync.
